notes: The route REACTION→USER→MESSAGE is realized literally in table order (message_reactions→users→messages): node1 (users) is the reactor via message_reactions.user_id, and node2 (messages) is a message authored by that SAME user via messages.user_id — this is exactly the intended semantics here, since the design requires the reactor to be the same person who authored one of the two CUDA-limit-identifying messages (self-consistent join, unlike a cross-person scenario). Filtering node2.message_id to the two known identifying messages (Priya's 1706001931.000000 and Lukas's 1706001890.000000) operationalizes 'authored a message identifying the CUDA memory limit finding' using the actual grounding messages from the design, not an arbitrary answer-shortcut. All five needed message_reactions rows target messages that already exist in the base seed, so no new messages were created. Actor U01AGENBOT9 was given membership in product-growth (C_GROWTH) — its only missing channel among those touched — so it can read Kenji's Tokyo message and Priya's negative thumbsup reaction there via documented APIs, completing workspace-wide discoverability. No other base_seed rows were altered.
